In the meantime, the state would authorise defense contractor Pegasus Systems to begin building and producing dozens of ISTAR systems integrated into orbital satellites to provide clear and clean data to the armed forces and the SCSID, along with the overall government, streamlining communications and moving towards a defense-oriented state posture. 

Further work would continue within the SCSID on the creation of a unified computer network for the government to utilise, with multi-layered defense and protection systems, relying on mass redundancy and a mixture of analog and modern systems to provide a layered network.

In a report to the triumvirate, the first phase of the UCC and Defense Upgrades, known as RoseNet 1.0, would be readied by mid-January 2028 if no setbacks occurred.

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;61188597]The government of Rosenmarkke has formally accepted the offer to meet diplomatically with the government of Flousechia, with consul Polenne Strømm being sent as a representative of the triumvirate.[/quote]
[quote=vespurias;61194512]His Imperial Majesty, former Emperor of Vespurians, the Archon of the Vespurians, Mr. Lux, accepts the invitation, and awaits an according date to set out on jet flight on the A1 to Flousechia alongside his habitual security and personal diplomatic entourage.[/quote]
The Floueschian Government in exile would also formally accept the offer, cautiously. 

________________________________________________________________

They would arrive in Floueschia in the morning, some light snow covering the ground from an earlier storm coming from the south. Téiernsbuer is the largest city in the entire Republic, and also its temporary capital for a few short months after the revolution. And to no surprise, the international airport they landed at, Téiernsbuer-Weber International, would also be the largest in the entire country. Once they had gotten settled in a closed of section of the airport, they would be informed by a repersentive of the Forigen Departmenet about what would happen during there state visit, first they would be treated to a state breakfast on the behalf of muller, then a press conference, with the Téiernsbuer branch of the Flouechia Star Daily being the primary press, if they had any questions they perfered not be asked, now was the time to inform the diplomat so he could call ahead. Then a tour of the city, which included a tour of the Avelishu Auto and Tank Plant just outside of the city, and lastly, a private conference followed by dinner. 

After this small information session, they would be picked up, a motorcade guarded by the IRG and Local City Gaurd would surround them as they began the drive to Republik Haus. The building was an old brick house, about the size of an urban mansion. Press would swarm around the police line as each repersentive stepped off there transports onto the grounds. Fredrich Muller would approach the main repersentive of each country to greet them personally before the official state flag-raising ceremony began.
